description: This Java source file defines the JavaEventHandler class, which implements event handling by dynamically loading classes and invoking specific methods in response to events within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages transaction boundaries and logs execution details.

classes.name: JavaEventHandler
classes.description: A class to handle web events by dynamically invoking specified static methods on classes corresponding to event paths within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class by its fully qualified name using the current thread's context class loader.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with a servlet context (no implementation here).

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles an event by loading the corresponding class, invoking the specified method with the request and response objects, managing transaction boundaries, logging the process, and handling exceptions.
